behavior: Usually secretive, skulking quietly in low, dense vegetation. Gleans insects and spiders from foliage, also eating berries and other fruit. During the breeding season, males sing varied whistles, cackles, rattles, and gurgles from exposed perches and may perform exaggerated display flights.
field_marks: Bright yellow throat and breast contrasting with a white lower belly
Olive-gray upperparts with olive-brown, rounded wings
Bold white spectacles around the dark eye and a white mustache stripe
Thick, dark bill set on a large gray head
Bulky, broad-chested body with a long olive-brown tail
habitat: Dense thickets, scrub, bramble tangles, forest edges and clearings, streamside shrubbery, and wetland margins; during migration and winter, favors similarly low, dense vegetation, scrub, and woodland edges.
